description: Identity checks mapped to NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls and CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model v2.0 Identity pillar functions.

rules.title: Privileged account without MFA
rules.remediation: Require phishing-resistant MFA for this account before any further privileged sign-in.

rules.title: Standard user account without MFA
rules.remediation: Enroll the user in MFA and block sign-in until enrollment is complete.

rules.title: Privileged account uses phishable MFA (SMS, voice, push, or code)
rules.remediation: Move administrators to phishing-resistant MFA such as FIDO2 security keys or certificate-based (PIV/CAC) authentication.

rules.title: Shared or generic account in use
rules.remediation: Replace the shared account with individually assigned accounts so every action is attributable to one person.

rules.title: Terminated person's account still enabled
rules.remediation: Disable the account immediately and connect HR offboarding to account deprovisioning.

rules.title: Enabled account inactive beyond the allowed period
rules.remediation: Disable the account, confirm with its owner whether it is still needed, and automate inactivity disabling.

rules.title: Account created but never used
rules.remediation: Disable unused accounts and create accounts only when a person starts work.

rules.title: Service account allows interactive sign-in
rules.remediation: Deny interactive and remote desktop logon rights to service accounts, or convert them to managed service identities.

rules.title: Service account password older than the allowed age
rules.remediation: Rotate the credential and move to automatically rotated credentials such as group managed service accounts.

rules.title: Admin rights on a daily-use account
rules.remediation: Give the administrator a separate admin-only account without email, and remove admin rights from the daily account.

rules.title: Guest or external account holds privileged access
rules.remediation: Remove privileged rights from external accounts, or grant them only through time-limited, approved access.

rules.title: Privileged access not reviewed within the review period
rules.remediation: Have the account's manager or system owner recertify the privileged access and record the review.

rules.title: Too many privileged accounts for the organization's size
rules.remediation: Reduce standing administrator accounts to the minimum needed and use time-limited elevation for occasional tasks.
